title: ROUND returns the nearest whole number, an exact half away from zero, and keeps large values
note: ROUND is not an IEC 61131-3 function: ZPLC defines it as the nearest whole REAL with an exact half away from zero (2.5 gives 3.0, -2.5 gives -3.0, 0.5 gives 1.0); 0.49999997 is below half and gives 0.0, and 3.0E9 has no fraction
